name: When is the best time of year to start a home addition project in the San Francisco Bay Area?
description: Spring through fall is often ideal for fewer weather delays, though Bay Area's mild climate allows year-round construction. Planning for permits is key.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a home addition project in the San Francisco Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: While construction can occur year-round, starting a home addition project in the dryer months, typically spring through fall, can often lead to fewer weather-related delays, especially for exterior work and foundation pouring. However, given the Bay Area's mild climate, significant delays due to weather are less common than in other regions. We plan projects to minimize impact regardless of the season, but considering the permit acquisition timeline, an early spring start allows exterior work to progress efficiently during drier periods.
